$comment: Mirror of sprk_analysisaction.sprk_inputschema for CREATE-TASK@v1 on spaarkedev1 — the CORRECTED shape after the G-P3 UAT round-1 incident (2026-07-07): the original row carried "required": true INSIDE the due_date/assign_to property definitions (invalid JSON Schema), and Azure OpenAI rejected the ENTIRE request (invalid_function_parameters) on every text-path turn. Required-ness is declared ONLY via the object-level required array. CI-validated against the OpenAI function-parameters subset by CatalogInputSchemaContractTests (H4).

fileIds.description: Optional subset of session file ids the task should be grounded in. Omit to use all session files.

due_date.elicitation_prompt: What's the due date for this task?
due_date.description: The task's due date as the user stated it (e.g. 7/9/2026).

assign_to.elicitation_prompt: Should I assign it to you or someone else?
assign_to.description: Who the task is assigned to — 'me' or a person's name.
